notes.title: 3rd Person Update
notes.notes:
Once player dies they can tab between any surviving agents and control them via 3rd person view.
Activatae this function by selecting the "E" key
Weapon sounds also upgraded.
Other bug fixes as well

notes.title: Build Version 9.1
notes.notes:
Updated Death animations
Enemy NPC cover animations now active
Various map improvements and updates

notes.title: Fox4Elite Update Alpha V0.09
notes.notes:
Game can now be played offline (massive coding project)
Hair rigs completed to improve performance, prevent hair slip bugs and have more natural movement
Death animation bug resulting in frozen animation and forward face plant fixed.
Abandoned Factory Map - numerous bug fixes to building sizes and collisions.
